newsitem.title: USA: Ampex says Maxtor to acquire keepered media.
newsitem.headline: Ampex says Maxtor to acquire keepered media.

text.p: Ampex Corp said on Monday that Maxtor Corp may acquire disk drive platters using its keepered media technology for disk drive programs in 1997.

The companies entered an agreement which sets prices and other terms but does not oblige Maxtor, a wholly-owned unit of Hyundai Electronics America, to complete any disk drive program or to buy a minimum number of keepered media disk platters, Ampex said in a statement.
Hyundai Electronics has set up Max Media, which will make disk drive platters for Maxtor starting in 1997.
Initially, the keepered media Ampex will supply to Maxtor is expected to be produced by one or more commercial manufacturers of disk drive platters and by Max Media, the company said.
Ampex previously said it does not have the facilities to manufacture commercial quantities of disk media and has not decided whether or not to invest in such facilities in the future.
